title: Bubbles searchable skill reference and capability map
disclaimer: A catalog entry is not a permission or an executable tool. Imported ChatGPT skill metadata is reference-only. Bubbles must independently implement, authenticate, test, and authorize each capability. Never copy ChatGPT private memory, tokens, session cookies or connector credentials.

localCapabilities.label: Personal context and memory
localCapabilities.description: Recall opt-in wallet-scoped Bubbles conversation history and saved synapses. Uses BubblesMemory, /v1/synapses and the owner conversation endpoint. Does not access ChatGPT private personal_context.
localCapabilities.requires: Verified wallet and enabled private memory

localCapabilities.label: Web, weather and read-only MCP
localCapabilities.description: Read-only tools in Bubbles MCP: web_search, weather_current, resonance_calculate, news_headlines; tool receipts determine actual success.
localCapabilities.requires: Deployed MCP gateway and server-side authorization

localCapabilities.label: Image attachments
localCapabilities.description: Attach a JPEG, PNG or WebP in the existing Bubbles chat image picker. Actual model processing depends on the receiving service.
localCapabilities.requires: Browser file permission and compatible chat service

localCapabilities.label: GitHub projects and builds
localCapabilities.description: Per-user GitHub App OAuth connection; repository actions require selected resources and verified write permissions. Owner Robot Brain actions are separate.
localCapabilities.requires: User GitHub consent and verified repository permissions

localCapabilities.label: Cloudflare deployments
localCapabilities.description: Cloudflare project operations require the user's separately approved and configured account access. A wallet login does not grant API permissions.
localCapabilities.requires: Cloudflare OAuth client, scopes, authorized deployment executor

localCapabilities.label: File and video attachment adapters
localCapabilities.description: Reference capability for future document and video uploads. Existing image attachment does not prove file/video processing.
localCapabilities.requires: Verified upload storage, media parser, limits, and privacy controls

localCapabilities.label: Robot Brain owner work
localCapabilities.description: Signed, owner-scoped, revocable Brain work ticket and receipt pipeline, separate from public chat.
localCapabilities.requires: Active five-day grant, verified Unified Wallet, approved scoped job

localCapabilities.label: Organic Computation research and simulation
localCapabilities.description: DARPA O-Circuit research plus a fixed-pattern digital memory benchmark. A read-only JavaScript execution adapter is implemented in Bubbles source and responds with measured counts, matched baseline accuracies and limitations. Live Cloudflare deployment is not yet verified.
localCapabilities.requires: Deploy exact reviewed bubbles-tools Worker version and confirm real /v1/assist and authenticated MCP receipts; software-only

referenceSkills.label: access protected vercel deployment
